lifecycle_domains.title: 1. 24/7 Ingestion & External Market Feeds
lifecycle_domains.flow: Dhan REST/WebSocket -> Instrument Master (136,670 rows) -> Rate-Limit Governor -> Ingestion Buffer
lifecycle_domains.storage: Local memory cache (instruments.json) + GCP Secret Manager (dhan-access-token)
lifecycle_domains.past_breakage: Dhan access token expired after 24h causing 401 unauthenticated errors and cold-start crashes.
lifecycle_domains.root_cause: In-process token auto-refresh caused race conditions and token invalidation on concurrent Cloud Run workers.
lifecycle_domains.remediation_applied: Decoupled rotation into dedicated GCP Cloud Run Job 'genesis-system3-dhan-token-rotate' executed every 5m via Cloud Scheduler.

lifecycle_domains.title: 2. 44-Field Option Chain & Greeks Engine
lifecycle_domains.flow: Dhan Scrip Master -> Strike Grids -> Black-Scholes Greeks Engine -> Moneyness & Buildup -> ATM Centering
lifecycle_domains.storage: Ephemeral in-memory cache with 5s TTL + Normalized 44-field payload
lifecycle_domains.past_breakage: /api/option-chain returned HTTP 404; missing Greeks (Delta, Gamma, Theta, Vega) and no buildup tags.
lifecycle_domains.root_cause: Legacy adapter returned unstandardized dictionary without moneyness offsets, Max Pain, or PCR context.
lifecycle_domains.remediation_applied: Engineered institutional 44-field normalized contract schema with symmetric ATM centering and Max Pain writer algorithms.

lifecycle_domains.title: 3. ML Feature Engineering & Tournament Engine
lifecycle_domains.flow: Historical Price/Volume -> 129 Technical/Fundamental Features -> LightGBM/XGBoost Tournament -> Out-of-Sample Calibration
lifecycle_domains.storage: GCS Bucket gs://system3-openalgo-safe-artifacts/models/ + Prediction Audit Log in Firestore
lifecycle_domains.past_breakage: Predictions lacked row-level lineage (prediction_id) and feature pipelines suffered lookahead bias.
lifecycle_domains.root_cause: Features computed across full dataset without strict point-in-time train/val splits.
lifecycle_domains.remediation_applied: Implemented 129-feature health monitor, leakage-safe OOS testing, and row-level prediction provenance IDs.

lifecycle_domains.title: 4. 24/7 Cloud Orchestration & Cloud Schedulers
lifecycle_domains.flow: Cloud Scheduler (5 CRON jobs) -> Pub/Sub Topics -> Cloud Run Background Workers -> Evidence Snapshots
lifecycle_domains.storage: GCP Cloud Scheduler + Cloud Run Job Revisions + Pub/Sub broker-token-rotate
lifecycle_domains.past_breakage: Unmonitored cron schedules had silent failures without alert escalation on missed ticks.
lifecycle_domains.root_cause: Lack of Cloud Monitoring execution-count metric alarms and absence of retry dead-letter queues.
lifecycle_domains.remediation_applied: Created 5-minute scheduler watchdogs and Cloud Monitoring alert policies for missed runs.

lifecycle_domains.title: 5. Institutional Paper Execution & Order State
lifecycle_domains.flow: Signal Generator -> Risk Gate Validation -> Institutional Slippage (0.05%) -> Firestore Order Book -> Position Tracking
lifecycle_domains.past_breakage: Calling /api/paper/positions threw unhandled 500 error when zero positions were present.
lifecycle_domains.root_cause: Backend expected local file system json on disk instead of querying Firestore state store.
lifecycle_domains.remediation_applied: Refactored positions endpoint to query Firestore collections with structured zero-state fallback.

lifecycle_domains.title: 6. Macro News, Catalysts & Event Intelligence
lifecycle_domains.flow: Macro Policy Feeds -> Entity NER Tagging -> Sentiment Weighting -> Gamma Watch Expiry Matrix
lifecycle_domains.storage: Firestore system3_catalysts + Cached in-memory catalyst models
lifecycle_domains.past_breakage: News and macro timeline routes returned 404; no linkage between events and stock symbols.
lifecycle_domains.root_cause: Catalyst feed was mock placeholder without real-world regulatory tracking.
lifecycle_domains.remediation_applied: Built live catalyst intelligence service tracking RBI MPC, ALMM Solar, Customs Duty, and F&O gamma watch.

lifecycle_domains.title: 7. Multibagger Fundamental & Technical Workspace
lifecycle_domains.flow: BSE/NSE Scrip Fundamentals -> 3Y Revenue CAGR + YoY Net Profit -> ROE/ROCE Filter -> Momentum Cards -> Thesis Panels
lifecycle_domains.storage: GCS research artifacts + Firestore candidate records
lifecycle_domains.past_breakage: Multibagger tab showed static mock wireframe with unclickable rows and missing financial metrics.
lifecycle_domains.root_cause: Backend endpoint /api/multibagger was unregistered in FastAPI router.
lifecycle_domains.remediation_applied: Constructed multi-factor scoring (0-100) with interactive thesis explain-why expansion panels.

lifecycle_domains.title: 8. Event-Driven Backtesting & Provenance Lake
lifecycle_domains.flow: Historical Tick Data -> Strategy Simulation -> Institutional Costs -> GCS Audit Manifest Export
lifecycle_domains.past_breakage: Backtest results claimed 'VERIFIED' without cryptographic dataset hash lineage.
lifecycle_domains.root_cause: Simulation ran on offline fixtures without registering dataset manifests in cloud storage.
lifecycle_domains.remediation_applied: Implemented mandatory GCS run_manifest.json export with SHA-256 dataset hash verification.
